description: This plot illustrates the loss over a number of iterations for six different model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 143,000, with tick marks spaced every 20,000 intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks spaced every 0.1 units. All six configurations are represented by solid lines without markers that exhibit slight noise, and all follow a similar trajectory: a steep initial decline from above the y-axis maximum of 3.4 near iteration 0, transitioning into a gradual, steady decrease for the remainder of the plot. The purple line, representing "Vanilla," ends at the lowest loss value of approximately 2.46 at the far right of the x-axis. The blue line, representing "StrmLLM (n=64)," remains the highest throughout the gradual decline phase, ending at approximately 2.61. The orange line, representing "SepLLM (n=64)," ends at approximately 2.53. The green line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)," ends at approximately 2.51. The dark blue line, representing "SepLLM (n=128)," ends at approximately 2.50. Finally, the red line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," ends at approximately 2.49.
